answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops a sybil spiral. Each agent burns 12 tokens for one paid work slot per epoch, gone either way. An honest agent pays 12 once and keeps the reward stream. An attacker cloning 1,000 identities burns 12,000 tokens to climb the same ridge, earning at most 400 back — a 30-to-1 loss. Every burn is public, so the jetty where new identities dock is visible: fresh slots from one referrer freeze until a peer audit clears them.
